title: Deep texture representation analysis for histopathological images
protocol: Select regions that represent the histological characteristics of the variables for analysis.
Ensure the selected ROI size is sufficiently large to accommodate at least one image patch in pixel dimensions.
Avoid areas with artifacts such as folded or torn tissue.
Exclude areas with non-uniform staining, excessive noise, normal tissues, and largely white areas without any tissues.
Select a histologically uniform area for applications described here.
Use glob.glob(os.path.join(WSI_dir, "∗/∗/∗.ndpi")) to get all WSI files in the chosen directory.
Open a file named "histopatch.sh" for writing.
